title: Why Your Webcam Still SUCKS!
summary: A short Techquickie explainer on why laptop webcams are much worse than phone cameras. It covers sensor size, image processing, and the interface differences between laptops and phones, with input from a Logitech engineer.
why: HN commenters link it when webcam quality comes up, as a quick rundown of why laptop webcams lag behind phones.
